svg.title: OVIP comparison diagram with top qualitative examples and bottom AP bar chart
svg.desc: Base frame f01 contains panel (a): a zebra photo at left, three rounded answer boxes with avatar icons and quoted labels, a vertical OVIP module, rightward gray arrows, and three face-result icons. The top section is organized horizontally from origin photo to labels to OVIP to outcomes, with repeated rows sharing horizontal alignment. Base frame f02 contains panel (b): AP (OV-COCO) axes, Novel/Base grouped horizontal bars for Original Label and Synonym, dashed reference lines, orange dashed performance degradation arrows, and legend. The bar chart uses a common left origin and proportional horizontal bar lengths. SAM mappings: original zebra photo-draft_photo-asset_sam_region_000026; top avatar-draft_avatar_horse-asset_sam_region_000024; middle avatar-draft_avatar_zebra-asset_sam_region_000023; bottom avatar-draft_avatar_hippo-asset_sam_region_000025; top sad face-draft_face_top-asset_sam_region_000021; middle smile face-draft_face_mid-asset_sam_region_000022; bottom sad face-draft_face_bot-asset_sam_region_000020.
